The tree shows a combobox with role 'combobox' and name 'notice-SG7H14R' that has options 'In Stock' (selected) and 'Out of Stock'. This is the stock status field. I must ensure not to change any other settings or language. After selecting 'Out of Stock', I should save the changes. The tree shows a 'Save' button in the main area. I'll click that to save. python_code:
async def act(page):
    # Select 'Out of Stock' from the stock status combobox
    stock_combobox = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="notice-SG7H14R")
    await stock_combobox.select_option("Out of Stock")
    # Click the Save button to apply changes
    save_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Save")
    await save_button.click()
    # Wait for the save operation to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # No further actions needed; task is complete
    return "Stock status changed to 'Out of Stock' and saved successfully."
